'''Kaesii DuPree''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Well, Hello! Are you planning to attend the VanDern's ball tonight. I hear all the best people from the rim are flying in to attend. I do hope you will be there.|Kaesii DuPree, to a passerby|<ref name="SWG:SLU" />}}
Kaesii DuPree was trained as a spy by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. During her training at the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]], she encountered a [[Unidentified genetically altered Twi'lek|man]] who became her lover.<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|191|Kaesii}}</ref> Kaesii and the man eventually completed their training and became spies for the Empire. However, although the man was later selected to join a spy elite corps, Kaesii was washed out of the program and assigned to Imperial Administration on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="Sony" /> Growing frustrated by this situation, she finally deserted shortly before the Battle of Yavin without leaving any trace, leaving her lover without a word. Kaesii DuPree fled to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] and established herself as a freelance spy and [[Forger (profession)/Legends|forger]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Joining the local criminal underworld, she worked to undermine [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's]] position on Tatooine.<ref name="TCSWE" /> After the Battle of Yavin, DuPree resided in the city of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] and used to work from the [[Lucky Despot]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]].<ref name="SWG:SLU" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Kaesii DuPree learnt that a manager of the [[White Thranta Shipping Company]], [[Durr Roddack]], had stolen plans for a military prototype [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]]. The White Thranta Shipping Company was a front for [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's]] [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|criminal organization]] but the Roddack had stolen the plans for his own profit, without informing Jabba. DuPree then dispatched a spy trained by her associate [[Lercer Gaia]] to infiltrate the [[White Thranta Shipping offices|White Thranta Shipping base]] to recover the plans. After the spy succeeded in the mission, Kaesii DuPre contacted one of Roddack's rivals to announce that she could sell him the plans. Durr Roddack learnt about the offer and started panicking, thereby convincing DuPre and her buyer that the plans were authentic. Finally, Kaesii DuPree threatened Roddack to reveal the theft of the plans to Jabba and blackmailed him to get extra money.<ref name="SWG:SLU" />

Kaesii DuPree later recommended the spy to another associate, [[Sarlis Beni]], for a mission with the objective to retrieve a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] with sensitive information stolen from the [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]] by a [[Eyan McDermitt's pirate gang|gang]] of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]].<ref name="SWG:PtB">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Spy|Paying the Bills|Tatooine}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Kaesii DuPree was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:SLU" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Kaesii DuPree was added to the game upon the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]", a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
